title: group_matches_pattern duplicates wildmat logic with different semantics
description: In crates/transit/src/main.rs, the function group_matches_pattern (line 1094) implements a simple trailing-star glob. The codebase also has the full wildmat engine in stoa_core::wildmat::matches_wildmat, which handles star anywhere in the pattern, question-mark, and is used everywhere else group patterns are matched (GroupFilter, list.rs, validate_article_ingress). A competent reader will immediately ask: why is a second, more limited pattern-matching function here instead of calling matches_wildmat? The doc comment explains the semantics but gives no rationale for not reusing the wildmat module. If the intent is to avoid importing stoa_core here for some reason, or if there is a deliberate semantic difference (e.g., trailing-star-only is intentional for pinning service group filters), that reason needs to be documented. Without it, a maintainer fixing a bug in group matching will fix it in matches_wildmat but not here, or vice versa, causing a silent behavioral divergence.
